usage: Use 紫水晶 to name the gemstone amethyst; it is a countable noun in everyday speech and jewelry contexts.
Common in shopping, accessories, and crystal-related topics; it often appears with words about necklaces, rings, bracelets, and earrings.
The word is neutral and standard, suitable for both spoken and written Cantonese.
For learners, remember the tone pattern: 紫 (zi2) + 水 (seoi2) + 晶 (zing1); the middle tone is low rising, so keep the rhythm clear.
